properties.name: Flood seen by radar, 22 July 2026
properties.source: Copernicus Sentinel-1 radar (RTC) from Microsoft Planetary Computer, mapped by NodiBondhu
properties.quality: Satellite observation from one moment, which can miss the peak and water that had already drained. Radar cannot see water under trees, tea gardens or in built-up areas, so real flooding was larger. Thresholds are simple and have not been checked on the ground. Compared with just before the flood, so water already there, such as wet rice fields, is left out
properties.event: 19 July 2026 flood in Sivasagar and Nazira
